decisions.finding: Beneath the initial Vav of וחֲבֵרָיו at x=210..235, high-resolution zoom 6 capture reveals a solid horizontal Patah bar spanning 26 pixels wide and 24 pixels tall (rows 653..676) stamped directly below the Vav stem, followed by 22 rows of clean white paper below. Distinct from Sheva; matches positive control Patah. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).

Beneath the initial Vav of ויֶּהֱדֹף at x=873..883, 32 consecutive vertical rows (rows 883..914) are 100% clean white paper (brightness 255.0). The initial Vav is printed unpointed without a vowel mark; the Segol and Dagesh are on the subsequent Yod (יֶּ). Confirmed unpointed consonant for initial Vav.
